title: NTSB's Grim Amazon Update, United Cancels Its Own 9/11 Flypast, and Hyatt Ditches American for Delta
summary: The NTSB drops new cockpit voice data from Sunday's fatal Miami crash, and it's about as bad as you'd expect. United quietly scraps a bizarre 9/11 tribute flight over Denver, Hyatt swaps American for Delta as its loyalty partner, and Frontier finally heads to South America. Plus, Air Canada's shiny new A321XLR already flopped on its biggest route.
